optimized_sql:
SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
FROM (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales,
           avg(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT i.i_manager_id, sum(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
        FROM (
            SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
            FROM item
            WHERE ((i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
                OR (i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')))
        ) AS i
        JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
        JOIN (
            SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
            FROM date_dim
            WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
        ) AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY i.i_manager_id, d.d_moy
    ) AS monthly_sales
) AS tmp1
WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
